name: Maximum Security & Patrol Services Ltd.
brand_truth: A Nassau firm that has put trained officers on posts since 1993, with one Carib Road office behind every service.
buyer: Facilities, operations and procurement managers at banks, retailers, offices and government in Nassau, plus property managers and private clients.

design.signature: Technical site plan (posts, patrol route with moving patrol, alarm sensors to monitoring, incident, survey) that highlights the chosen service layer

current_site_findings: maximumsecurityservice.com (in their listings) no longer resolves
Only phone and fax on directories; no email or proposal path
Company story only on a third-party directory
Services not explained for procurement managers
No Google-readable page for 'security company Nassau'
pitch_line: Your old website address is dead; here is the site that tells Nassau's facility managers you have put trained officers on posts since 1993, and gets them to call you with their needs already written down.
assumptions: 'Patrols' as a service line (from company name and job titles)
Example settings for officers (gates, lobbies, banking halls, stores, events) and sector examples are category-standard
'Have these answers ready' questions on services.html are generic intake questions
Service area shown as New Providence
notes: Track B, domain lost (maximumsecurityservice.com fails DNS). Still trading per URCA register May 2024 and directory updates 2022. No email published, so proposal builder produces a read-out summary plus two Call buttons. No photos found: art-directed with a technical plan illustration. Avoided repeating the company's 'largest provider' self-claim; the quote used is labelled as the company's own description. Ask owner for email, hours, licences, photos of officers and vehicles. Scorecard: hero 4, type 4, layout 4, context 4, motion 4, depth 4, detailing 5, mobile 4, refs 4, pride 4, consistency 4.
